svg.title: Menus and Buttons
svg.desc: Menus and buttons of the MagicFocus screen, page by page, with numbers only on what is not obvious from the screen; every other button does what its label says, and only the orange-numbered ones do something else when held. On every tab: hold the lens name for a second to lock or unlock the lens, shown by a red padlock, so taps cannot switch it; the number in front of the name is its slot in lenses.txt. Tap the battery to switch between volts and percent; it turns green while charging and red below 15%. MagicFocus tab: tap the Lidar and Lens readout to switch between numbers and a graph of the last 10 seconds, drawn here and enlarged below the screen, with the distance to the subject from the lidar in orange and the distance the lens is focused at in blue. Camera links a Blackmagic camera on a Core2, whose lens is then picked even when the lens is locked. The motor button shows Motor OK, No motor or No bridge, the H2 not answering, and a tap checks the radio again. Calib. tab: tap the step for the next distance, 0.5, 2 or 4 m, where a green dot means a point is saved for it; hold an arrow to keep the motor turning, faster after a second; the middle shows the motor position, 0 to 4095, and the lower left the distance to the subject. AF Curve tab: each button sketches how the lens gets to focus, with the goal as a grey line, and the Speed button on the MagicFocus tab sets how fast. Good to know page: drag the text to scroll. Core2 only: a PIN keypad appears the first time a Blackmagic camera pairs, and holding button C for 2 seconds switches the Core2 off.
